long.title: 10 Weird Breakfast Gadgets That Got Real Patents

shorts.title: This Is a Real Patent for a Square Egg
shorts.line: A hard-boiled egg, pressed into a cube. Even the yolk comes out square.

shorts.title: This Is a Real Patent for a Cereal Slide
shorts.line: Two bowls and a slide, so your cereal never gets soggy. Approved or denied?

shorts.title: The U.S. Approved a Grapefruit Shield
shorts.line: A glass shield for half a grapefruit, so the juice can't spray. You eat through a window.
